div.div: A new person signs up. The Auth Service creates their profile in the User Service, gives them the default USER role, stores a six-digit code for 15 minutes and asks the Mail Service to send it. If any later step fails, the profile and roles already created are rolled back, so a half-finished account never stays behind (saga compensation).
